about: TennisRecs starter catalog. Values from the makers' pages (Wilson US/UK, Babolat US, Head US, Yonex global, Tecnifibre international, Prince Japan for the Tour 98) checked and approved by the owner on 2026-10-19. Stiffness is Tennis Warehouse's lab measurement for every racket (one comparable scale). Where the maker gives no weight or balance, Tennis Warehouse's figure is used and marked 'strung'. Names follow the maker's generation (V10, Gen9, 8th gen, or Head's year); no model years. Wilson publishes weight and balance without units (grams and cm, matching Tennis Warehouse). Pro Staff 97 V14 is 97 sq in (Wilson US and Tennis Warehouse; Wilson UK shows 98). Babolat's '100.01' and '300.01' read as 100 and 300. Columns: shape = head size, core = string pattern, surface = stiffness. Expansion (2026-10-21, owner chose current plus previous generation): 311 more rackets from the current and previous generation of each line, adding Dunlop, Volkl, Solinco and ProKennex. Their head size, string pattern, strung weight, balance (points head-light/head-heavy, strung) and stiffness all come from Tennis Warehouse's Racquet Finder, so every value is on the same scale; colourways, signature editions and juniors are left out. Names follow the maker's generation (V9/V10, Gen8/Gen9, 7th/8th gen) or the model year where the maker uses years (Head, Dunlop, Babolat Evo/Boost, older Prince and ProKennex). Added on 2026-10-21 from reviews held as missing products: values from the linked page only, blank where it gives none. Both from Tennis Warehouse Europe.
